dz: 在开罗揭露了一场反对萨拉丁的阴谋,其目的是恢复法蒂米德哈里发,前法蒂米德政权的高级人物和诗人乌马拉·雅马尼也参与了这场阴谋. 现代历史学家怀疑官方来源所报道的阴谋的程度和危险,但其头目会在随后的几周被公开处决.
de: A conspiracy against Saladin, aiming to restore the Fatimid Caliphate, is revealed in Cairo, involving senior figures of the former Fatimid regime and the poet Umara al-Yamani. Modern historians doubt the extent and danger of the conspiracy reported in official sources, but its ringleaders will be publicly executed over the following weeks.

te: Baldwin IV, 13, becomes King of Jerusalem, with Raymond III of Tripoli as regent and William of Tyre as chancellor.
dz: 鲍德温四世13岁成为耶路撒冷国王,的黎波里的雷蒙德三世出任摄政,提尔的威廉出任执政官.

de: William I of Scotland, a key rebel in the Revolt of 1173–74, is captured at Alnwick by forces loyal to Henry II of England.
